key_insight: QPI-DeepONet-MAC is a hybrid classical-quantum physics-informed operator network that aims to keep DeepONet expressivity while improving trainability and stability for solving parametric PDEs.
engineering_relevance: The framework could enable scalable surrogate models for high-dimensional physics simulations, especially where classical PI-DeepONets struggle with optimization and sample efficiency.
method: Uses a multiplicative-and-additive coupling (MAC) between classical DeepONet features and quantum expectation values.
Integrates parameterized quantum circuits into a physics-informed operator-learning pipeline.
Adds analytical trainability and regularization tools to reduce barren plateaus and coherence loss.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports analytic proofs and derived bounds: universal operator approximation, gradient bounds for avoiding barren plateaus, and a lower bound on required sensors tied to regularity, dimension, and PDE growth.
watch_item: Practical performance may depend on circuit size, noise sensitivity, and whether the quantum components remain trainable at scale on near-term hardware.
paper_title: QPI-DeepONet-MAC: A Scalable and Stable Hybrid Classical-Quantum Architecture for Physics-Informed Deep Operator Networks
